purpose: Production-ready handoff for Claude Code: individual PNG components are already separated from the source sheet.
do_not: Do not ask Claude Code to crop the sheet.
Do not use the large assembled image as a single drawable for the character.
Do not downscale the source parts before rigging.
Do not redesign the character without explicit instruction.

use.base_character: Assemble the separated base parts into one Spine rigid cutout skeleton.
use.equipment: Future armor/clothing/weapons should be added as separate attachments/skins.
use.runtime_scale: The PNG source can be rendered substantially smaller in the game (approximately 50% is acceptable as a starting point).

folders.reference: Original sheet and assembled visual references only.

filtering: Use nearest-neighbor / point filtering for pixel-art assets.
animation: Prefer rigid cutout transforms over mesh deformation.
